title: Mindbody Pricing 2026: Plans, Fees & Add-ons Explained
description: Mindbody pricing explained: $79/mo Starter per location, unpublished Accelerate and Ultimate prices, processing and Mindbody app fees, add-ons. Sourced.
h1: Mindbody pricing: plans, fees and add-ons (2026)
body:
Mindbody publishes one number: plans start at $79/mo per location (North America and Asia). That is the Starter plan. Accelerate and Ultimate have no published price; every plan button on the pricing page says "Let's talk", and Mindbody asks you to contact sales about discounts. This page lays out everything Mindbody does publish about cost, plan by plan, plus the fees that sit outside the subscription.

We checked Mindbody's own pricing page, Mindbody Payments page and Mindbody app (marketplace) page on November 2, 2026. Anything Mindbody doesn't publish is marked unknown. We have not used Mindbody ourselves, we don't publish ratings, and Mindbody doesn't pay us.

Mindbody plans and prices

PlanPublished priceWhat it adds
StarterFrom $79/mo per locationBooking, integrated payments, branded website widgets, a Customized Website, Mindbody app listing, basic reporting, unlimited users
Accelerateunknown (talk to sales)Everything in Starter plus advanced reporting and analytics, room and resource management, client Pick-a-Spot, promo codes, access to premium add-ons
Ultimateunknown (talk to sales)Everything in Accelerate plus automated email and text campaigns, lead management dashboard, AI Concierge included, a monthly text bundle and lower rates on marketing emails and texts
Enterpriseunknown (custom plan)For multi-location and franchise businesses

The $79 figure is per location, so two locations start at $158/mo on Starter. Mindbody says prices go up with new locations, not with staff: every plan includes unlimited users per location.

Add-ons and what they cost

  • Branded mobile app: not available on Starter; an add-on on Accelerate and Ultimate. Price unknown.
  • AI Concierge (24/7 AI front desk for missed calls and bookings): not available on Starter, an add-on on Accelerate, included in Ultimate. Add-on price unknown.
  • Text messages: all plans include unlimited booking confirmations and reminders by email; Accelerate and above add unlimited confirmations and reminders by text. Ultimate includes a monthly text bundle, and Mindbody says extra texts are "a fraction of a cent each". Exact rate unknown.
  • Data transfer from your old software: Mindbody offers it but says "fees may apply". Premium implementation, custom data conversion and Technical Account Management are priced separately. Prices unknown.
  • Onboarding: Mindbody says there is no onboarding fee on any plan and 1:1 setup is included.
  • Card readers: Mindbody lists the Stripe Reader S710, Stripe Reader M2 and WisePad. Hardware prices aren't on the pages we checked.

Payment processing fees

Mindbody Payments is optional. Mindbody says you can run its software with a third-party processor instead. If you use Mindbody Payments, the pricing page says you pay a processing rate that varies by card type and by card-present vs card-not-present, plus a fixed $0.10-$0.30 per transaction (North America and Asia). The percentage rate itself is not published. The payments page says there are no extra monthly fees, setup fees or long-term contracts for Mindbody Payments. Get the rate in writing before you sign; our billing software guide shows how other vendors publish theirs.

Mindbody app (marketplace) fees

Listing your studio on the Mindbody app is free on every plan. Mindbody's pricing page says a fee applies only when the app brings you a client who is new to your business: 20% of that client's first purchase, capped at $30 (or 30 in local currency). Later purchases by that client are commission-free, and there's no fee when an existing client books through the app, comes through your tracked referral link, or says they found you another way.

Two other marketplace tools are pay-per-sale: promoted intro offers and dynamic pricing (flexible prices on open class spots). Mindbody says you only pay when they generate a sale, but doesn't publish the rate. Bookings through Mindbody affiliates such as Google "may include a separate fee or revenue share", and standard processing fees apply to all app transactions. App bookings are paid out daily on business days, net of fees.

Contract and cancellation

Mindbody doesn't publish a standard contract length. Its FAQ says your contract depends on the plan, billing terms and any promotion you signed up with, and cancellation "may require advance notice" based on your agreement. A free trial isn't advertised; Mindbody offers a personalized demo instead. Ask for the term, notice period and renewal terms in writing.

What a small studio pays (published numbers only)

  • One location, any number of staff, Starter: from $79/mo, plus processing (rate unknown + $0.10-$0.30 per transaction), plus 20% (max $30) on the first purchase of each new client the Mindbody app sends you.
  • Room booking, Pick-a-Spot or a branded app: you need Accelerate or Ultimate, and neither price is published.
  • Automated email/text marketing and lead pipeline: Ultimate only, price not published.

Plug your own membership numbers into our membership revenue calculator to see what share of revenue the software would take.

How Mindbody's published pricing compares

Other studio platforms publish more of their price list. All prices below are from each vendor's own pricing page; see the tool pages for sources and dates.

  • WellnessLiving: $69/mo Starter (1 staff member), $199/mo Business with unlimited staff, $349/mo BusinessPro with a white-label app. Full breakdown in WellnessLiving vs Mindbody.
  • Vagaro: $30/mo for one bookable calendar, $10/mo per extra calendar in the US.
  • Arketa: $49/mo billed annually for the Individual plan (one login).
  • Walla: $299/mo per location with unlimited users.

faq: How much does Mindbody cost per month?

Mindbody's pricing page says plans start at $79/mo per location (North America and Asia) for the Starter plan, checked November 2, 2026. Accelerate and Ultimate prices are not published; Mindbody asks you to talk to sales.
Does Mindbody charge per staff member?
No. Mindbody says every plan includes unlimited users per location. The price rises when you add locations, not staff.
What are Mindbody's payment processing fees?

With Mindbody Payments you pay a processing rate that varies by card type and transaction type, plus a fixed $0.10-$0.30 per transaction in North America and Asia. Mindbody doesn't publish the percentage rate. You can use a third-party processor instead.
How much does Mindbody take from app bookings?

Listing on the Mindbody app is free. When the app sends you a client who is new to your business, Mindbody charges 20% of that client's first purchase, capped at $30. Later purchases are commission-free. Promoted intro offers, dynamic pricing and affiliate bookings (such as Google) can carry separate fees that Mindbody doesn't publish.
Is there a setup fee or a free trial?
Mindbody says there is no onboarding fee on any plan, though moving data from your old software may carry a fee. Mindbody doesn't advertise a free trial; it offers a personalized demo.
Does Mindbody include a branded app?
Not on Starter. The branded app is an add-on on Accelerate and Ultimate, and its price isn't published.
